content:
Apple TV subscribers can now watch the first two episodes of "Last Seen," an Australian kidnapping thriller starring Patrick Brammall from "Glitch." Check out the trailer below.

The first two episodes of "Last Seen" are now streaming on Apple TV.

Apple TV unveiled "Last Seen" less than a month ago, and the first two episodes of the new six-episode thriller are already here.

Based on award-winning author Ryan David Jahn's novel "The Dispatcher," new episodes will drop every Wednesday through October 7.

"Last Seen" kicks off Apple's fall slate, which also includes Season 6 of "Slow Horses," "Brothers" starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, and the debut of "Matchbox: The Movie," plus Season 2 of "Where's Wanda?" and more.

The platform also just premiered "Mayday," starring Ryan Reynolds ("Deadpool") and Kenneth Branagh ("Oppenheimer").
